newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse freezes UAE firm share over results.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse freezes UAE firm share over results.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) on Tuesday suspended trade in the shares of the United Arab Emirates' Umm al-Quwain Cement Company until the firm presents its annual results, a KSE statement said.
KSE had warned that it would suspend the cement firm's shares if it did not present the 1996 results to KSE by April 15, an official told Reuters on Monday.
The firm notified KSE that it would supply the required figures after the Moslem Eid al-Adha holiday which ends on April 21, the bourse said.
Its share closed at 104 fils ($0.34) on April 20, reaching the year's peak on March 30. Dealers said the market was expecting strong 1996 profits.
There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
